# Telangana Gaddar Film Award for Best Feature Film

This is the list of winners of the Telangana Gaddar Film Award for Best Feature Films since 2014. The awards are instituted in 2025 in the honor of revolutionary Telugu poet Gaddar. The Awards are instituted in the year 2025 and honored films released from 2014 since its inception.
